name: kakiguard
description: KakiGuard — community-powered scam protection for Singapore (NCS Hackathon 2026)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app -c green,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n api,app -c green,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:https --prefix client"
